//! Historical row transforms, separate from application-callable programs.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000.002#2-language — the compiler and raw-schema boundary share a closed expression fragment.
use super::*;
use crate::ir::{Builtin, Expr, Program, ProgramKind, Stmt};
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Backfill {
    pub table: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub inputs: BTreeMap<String, ColumnType>,
    pub outputs: BTreeSet<String>,
    pub program: Program,
}
impl Backfill {
    pub fn key(&self) -> String { digest(&self.normalized()) }
    pub fn normalized(&self) -> Self {
        // Locations are diagnostic metadata, never transformation identity.
        let mut normalized = self.clone();
        fn expr(e: &mut Expr) {
            match e {
                Expr::Get(r) | Expr::Exists(r) => { r.site.clear(); for e in &mut r.key { expr(e); } }
                Expr::Scan(r) => {
                    r.site.clear();
                    for k in &mut r.prefix { if let crate::ir::IndexKeyExpr::Scalar(e)=k {expr(e);} }
                    if let Some(e)=&mut r.filter {expr(e);}
                    if let Some(r)=&mut r.range {for e in [&mut r.gt,&mut r.gte,&mut r.lt,&mut r.lte].into_iter().flatten(){expr(e);}}
                }
                Expr::Field { base, .. } | Expr::Unary { value: base, .. } => expr(base),
                Expr::Array(es) | Expr::Builtin { args: es, .. } => { for e in es { expr(e); } }
                Expr::Object(fs) => { for e in fs.values_mut() { expr(e); } }
                Expr::Shape { base, fields } => { expr(base); for e in fields.values_mut() { expr(e); } }
                Expr::Binary { left, right, .. } => { expr(left); expr(right); }
                Expr::Block { body, value } => { statements(body); expr(value); }
                _ => (),
            }
        }
        fn statements(body: &mut [Stmt]) {
            for s in body {
                match s {
                    Stmt::Let { value, .. } | Stmt::Const { value, .. } | Stmt::Assign { value, .. } | Stmt::Return(value) => expr(value),
                    Stmt::Require { condition, site, .. } => { *site=None; expr(condition); },
                    Stmt::If { condition, then_body, else_body } => { expr(condition); statements(then_body); statements(else_body); }
                    _ => (),
                }
            }
        }
        statements(&mut normalized.program.body);
        normalized
    }
    pub fn admit(&self, schema: &Schema) -> Result<(), String> {
        let table = schema.table(&self.table).ok_or("backfill names an absent table")?;
        if table.ephemeral.is_some() || schema.maintain_for(&self.table).is_some() { return Err("backfill requires an authoritative durable table".into()); }
        if self.program.kind != ProgramKind::Query || self.program.native || self.outputs.is_empty() { return Err("backfill must produce a nonempty object patch".into()); }
        for c in &self.outputs {
            let kind = table.columns.get(c).ok_or_else(||format!("backfill output {}.{c} is not declared",self.table))?;
            if c=="id" || table.engine_field(c) || table.maintained.contains_key(c) || table.expire.as_ref()==Some(c) || table.not_before.as_ref()==Some(c) || !scalar(kind) {
                return Err(format!("backfill output {}.{c} must be an authoritative scalar, not an asset, lifetime or captured field",self.table));
            }
        }
        if !body(&self.program.body,schema) { return Err("backfill expressions allow deterministic scalar transforms, unique point lookups and bounded existence; no viewer, clock, ids, row collections, loops or writes".into()); }
        Ok(())
    }
}
fn scalar(k: &ColumnType) -> bool {
    match k {
        ColumnType::Optional(k) => scalar(k),
        ColumnType::Image { .. } | ColumnType::Video { .. } | ColumnType::File { .. } | ColumnType::List { .. } | ColumnType::ListRange { .. } => false,
        _ => true,
    }
}
fn body(stmts: &[Stmt], s: &Schema) -> bool {
    stmts.iter().all(|stmt| match stmt {
        Stmt::Let { value, .. } | Stmt::Const { value, .. } | Stmt::Assign { value, .. } | Stmt::Return(value) => expr(value,s),
        Stmt::Require { condition, .. } => expr(condition,s),
        Stmt::If { condition, then_body, else_body } => expr(condition,s) && body(then_body,s) && body(else_body,s),
        _ => false,
    })
}
fn expr(e: &Expr, s: &Schema) -> bool {
    match e {
        Expr::Literal(_) | Expr::Variable(_) => true,
        Expr::Input(_) | Expr::Merge(_) => false,
        Expr::Scan(r) => r.existence && r.after.is_none() && r.before.is_none() && r.prefix.iter().all(|k| k.scalar().is_some_and(|e|expr(e,s))) && r.filter.as_ref().is_none_or(|e|expr(e,s)) && r.range.as_ref().is_none_or(|r|[&r.gt,&r.gte,&r.lt,&r.lte].iter().all(|e|e.as_ref().is_none_or(|e|expr(e,s)))),
        Expr::Field { base, .. } | Expr::Unary { value: base, .. } => expr(base,s),
        Expr::Array(es) => es.iter().all(|e|expr(e,s)),
        Expr::Object(es) => es.values().all(|e|expr(e,s)),
        Expr::Shape { base, fields } => expr(base,s) && fields.values().all(|e|expr(e,s)),
        Expr::Binary { left, right, .. } => expr(left,s) && expr(right,s),
        Expr::Block { body: stmts, value } => body(stmts,s) && expr(value,s),
        Expr::Get(r) | Expr::Exists(r) => s.table(&r.table).is_some_and(|t| t.index(&r.index).is_some_and(|i|i.unique && i.is_plain() && i.components.len()==r.key.len())) && r.key.iter().all(|e|expr(e,s)),
        Expr::Builtin { builtin, args } => matches!(builtin,
            Builtin::RequireUncapped | Builtin::ProjectFields { .. } | Builtin::OptionalField { .. } | Builtin::Len | Builtin::Count | Builtin::Slice | Builtin::Concat | Builtin::Lower | Builtin::Trim | Builtin::Text(_) | Builtin::Sha256 | Builtin::First | Builtin::Last | Builtin::At | Builtin::Min | Builtin::Max | Builtin::Divide { .. } | Builtin::Civil(_) | Builtin::Calendar { .. }
        ) && args.len()==builtin.arity() && args.iter().all(|e|expr(e,s)),
    }
}
//! Bind historical arguments without requiring them in the current row type.
use super::*;
use crate::{ast, diag::{type_error, unknown}, types::{Ty, scalar_to_column}};
use snapback4_core::schema::backfill::Backfill;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
pub(super) fn bind(catalog: &Catalog, schema: &mut Schema, diagnostics: &mut Vec<Diagnostic>) {
    let mut names = BTreeSet::new(); let mut outputs = BTreeSet::new();
    for d in catalog.documents.iter().flat_map(|d| &d.backfills) {
        if !names.insert((d.table.clone(),d.name.clone())) { diagnostics.push(unknown(&d.site,"duplicate backfill name on this table","give each historical transform its own name")); continue; }
        let decl = ast::ProgramDecl { delivery: None, held:false, predicts:false, server:false, kind:ast::ProgramKind::Query,
            name: format!("backfill{}{}",d.table,d.name), args:d.args.clone(), prelude:vec![],
            body:vec![ast::Stmt::Return { value:d.value.clone(), site:d.site.clone() }], native:false, site:d.site.clone() };
        let Some(bound) = program::Binder::bind(catalog,schema,"schema",&decl,diagnostics) else {continue};
        let Ty::Object(fields) = &bound.result else { diagnostics.push(type_error(&d.site,"backfill returns an object patch","{ column: historicalValue }")); continue; };
        let Some(table) = schema.table(&d.table) else {diagnostics.push(unknown(&d.site,"backfill table is not declared","declare the candidate table"));continue};
        for (c,ty) in fields {
            if let Some(kind) = table.columns.get(c) {
                if !ty.assignable_to(&Ty::from_column(kind)) { diagnostics.push(type_error(&d.site,format!("backfill {}.{c} returns {}, expected {}",d.table,ty.name(),kind),"return a value fitting the candidate column")); }
            }
            if !outputs.insert((d.table.clone(),c.clone())) { diagnostics.push(type_error(&d.site,format!("backfills overlap on {}.{c}",d.table),"combine simultaneous outputs in one backfill")); }
        }
        let fill = Backfill { table:d.table.clone(), name:d.name.clone(), inputs:d.args.iter().map(|a|(a.name.clone(),scalar_to_column(&a.type_))).collect::<BTreeMap<_,_>>(), outputs:fields.keys().cloned().collect(), program:bound.program };
        if let Err(why) = fill.admit(schema) { diagnostics.push(type_error(&d.site,why,"use deterministic historical fields and a scalar patch").guide("deploy")); }
        schema.backfills.push(fill.normalized());
    }
}
//! Release backfills use the same activation transaction as retention and indexes.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000.002#3-adoption-and-reversibility — stage every result before mutating the input snapshot.
use super::*;
use crate::{schema::{backfill::Backfill, materialize_optional_fields}, engine::{Context, runner::Runner}, meter::{Ceilings, Cut, Meter}};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
pub(crate) const VERSION: &str = "snapback4-release-store-4";
fn refusal(message: impl Into<String>) -> RuntimeError { RuntimeError::Structural { code:"E_ADOPT", message:message.into() } }
fn present(tx: &Tx<'_>) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    Ok(tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name='_backfill_evidence')",[],|r|r.get(0))?)
}
fn enable(tx: &Tx<'_>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    tx.conn().execute_batch("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _backfill_evidence(t INTEGER NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,definition TEXT NOT NULL,inputs TEXT NOT NULL,before_image TEXT NOT NULL,after_image TEXT NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL,epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,PRIMARY KEY(t,id,definition)) WITHOUT ROWID;
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _backfill_pruned(t INTEGER NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,definition TEXT NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(t,id,definition)) WITHOUT ROWID;
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _backfill_definitions(digest TEXT PRIMARY KEY,definition TEXT NOT NULL);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _backfill_absence(t INTEGER NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,definition TEXT NOT NULL,column_name TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(t,id,definition,column_name)) WITHOUT ROWID;
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _backfill_inputs(t INTEGER NOT NULL,column_name TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(t,column_name)) WITHOUT ROWID;
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _backfill_active(t INTEGER NOT NULL,definition TEXT NOT NULL,input_names TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(t,definition)) WITHOUT ROWID;")?;
    if !tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pragma_table_info('_backfill_evidence') WHERE name='epoch')",[],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? {
        tx.conn().execute_batch("ALTER TABLE _backfill_evidence ADD COLUMN epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;")?;
    }
    if !tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pragma_table_info('_backfill_active') WHERE name='input_names')",[],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? {
        tx.conn().execute_batch("ALTER TABLE _backfill_active ADD COLUMN input_names TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]';")?;
    }
    tx.set_meta("version", VERSION)
}
#[derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
struct Evidence { #[serde(default)] absent:BTreeSet<String>, #[serde(default)] epoch:i64, active:bool, inputs: Value, before: BTreeMap<String,Value>, after: BTreeMap<String,Value> }
fn evidence(tx: &Tx<'_>, t:i64,id:&str,key:&str) -> Result<Option<Evidence>,RuntimeError> {
    let bytes:Option<i64>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT octet_length(inputs)+octet_length(before_image)+octet_length(after_image) FROM _backfill_evidence WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND definition=?3",params![t,id,key],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
    let mut admission=Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort);admission.heap(bytes.unwrap_or(0).max(0) as u64 * 64 + 8192)?;
    let value:Option<(String,String,String,bool,i64)>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT inputs,before_image,after_image,active,epoch FROM _backfill_evidence WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND definition=?3",params![t,id,key],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?,r.get(2)?,r.get(3)?,r.get(4)?))).optional()?;
    value.map(|(inputs,before,after,active,epoch)|Ok(Evidence {absent:absence(tx,t,id,key)?,epoch,active,inputs:decode(&inputs)?,before:decode(&before)?,after:decode(&after)?})).transpose()
}
fn decode<T:serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(s:&str)->Result<T,RuntimeError>{serde_json::from_str(s).map_err(|e|RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))}
fn absence(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str,key:&str)->Result<BTreeSet<String>,RuntimeError>{
    Ok(tx.conn().prepare("SELECT column_name FROM _backfill_absence WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND definition=?3")?.query_map(params![t,id,key],|r|r.get(0))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?)
}
fn save(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str,key:&str,e:&Evidence,active:bool)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO _backfill_evidence(t,id,definition,inputs,before_image,after_image,active,epoch) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,?7,?8) ON CONFLICT(t,id,definition) DO UPDATE SET inputs=excluded.inputs,before_image=excluded.before_image,after_image=excluded.after_image,active=excluded.active,epoch=excluded.epoch",params![t,id,key,canonical_json(&e.inputs),canonical_json(&e.before),canonical_json(&e.after),active,e.epoch])?;
    tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _backfill_pruned WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND definition=?3",params![t,id,key])?;
    tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _backfill_absence WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND definition=?3",params![t,id,key])?;
    for c in &e.absent {tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO _backfill_absence VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4)",params![t,id,key,c])?;}
    Ok(())
}
pub(super) fn delete(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    if present(tx)? {
        tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _backfill_evidence WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id])?;
        tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _backfill_pruned WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id])?;
        tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _backfill_absence WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id])?;
    } Ok(())
}
// Never archive reference/asset preimages without lifetime evidence. New reference
// fields are safe: subsequent retirement is owned by the ordinary dormant ledger.
fn protected(kind:&crate::schema::ColumnType)->bool {
    use crate::schema::ColumnType::*;
    match kind {Optional(k)=>protected(k),Ref{..}|Image{..}|Video{..}|File{..}|List{..}|ListRange{..}=>true,_=>false}
}
pub(super) fn transition(tx:&Tx<'_>,next:&Schema,previous:Option<&Schema>,sources:&BTreeMap<String,Table>,now:i64,report:&mut super::adoption_report::AdoptionReport)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    if next.backfills.is_empty() && previous.is_none_or(|s|s.backfills.is_empty()) && !present(tx)? { return Ok(()); }
    enable(tx)?;
    for fill in &next.backfills { fill.admit(next).map_err(refusal)?; }
    // A name is immutable within a continuous lineage. Replacing a transform
    // deliberately goes through an old-source/bridge transition first.
    if let Some(old)=previous {for f in &next.backfills {if old.backfills.iter().any(|p|p.table==f.table && p.name==f.name && p.key()!=f.key()) {return Err(refusal(format!("backfill {} {} changed; use a new name in a bridge release rather than replacing historical meaning",f.table,f.name)));}}}
    for fill in &next.backfills {
        tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _backfill_definitions VALUES(?1,?2)",params![fill.key(),canonical_json(fill)])?;
    }
    let next_keys:BTreeSet<_>=next.backfills.iter().map(Backfill::key).collect();
    let definitions:Vec<Backfill>=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT definition FROM _backfill_definitions WHERE digest IN (SELECT definition FROM _backfill_evidence WHERE active=1 UNION SELECT definition FROM _backfill_pruned WHERE active=1) ORDER BY digest")?.query_map([],|r|r.get::<_,String>(0))?.map(|s|decode(&s?)).collect::<Result<_,RuntimeError>>()?;
    for fill in definitions.iter().rev().filter(|f|!next_keys.contains(&f.key())) {
        let Some(table)=next.table(&fill.table) else {continue};
        let t=tx.num(&fill.table)?;let key=fill.key();let mut bad=super::adopt_refusals::Samples::default();let mut count=0;
        super::activation::walk(tx,t,|id,mut row|{
            let Some(e)=evidence(tx,t,id,&key)? else {
                let pruned:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _backfill_pruned WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND definition=?3 AND active=1)",params![t,id,key],|r|r.get(0))?;
                if pruned && fill.outputs.iter().any(|c|table.columns.contains_key(c)) {bad.add(id,"rollback preimage was explicitly pruned; select a bridge preserving current data or restore a backup");}
                return Ok(())
            };
            if !e.active {return Ok(())}
            let fields=match &mut row {Value::Row(f)|Value::Map(f)=>f,_=>return Err(refusal("invalid stored row"))};
            let mut changed=false;
            for c in &fill.outputs {if table.columns.contains_key(c) {
                let current=fields.get(c);let before=e.before.get(c);let after=e.after.get(c);
                if current!=after && current!=before {bad.add(id,&format!("{}.{} changed after backfill {}; keep a bridge and repair through an authorized mutation before rollback",fill.table,c,fill.name));return Ok(())}
                if let Some(value)=before {fields.insert(c.clone(),value.clone());}else{fields.remove(c);}
                changed=true;
            }}
            if changed {tx.conn().execute("UPDATE r SET data=?1 WHERE t=?2 AND id=?3",params![canonical_json(&row),t,id])?;count+=1;}
            save(tx,t,id,&key,&e,false)
        })?;
        if bad.count>0 {return Err(refusal(format!("backfill {} {} rollback: {}",fill.table,fill.name,bad.describe())))}
        if count>0 {report.backfills.push(format!("{} {} reversed on {count} {}",fill.table,fill.name,if count==1 {"row"}else{"rows"}));tx.set_meta("activation_population","true")?;}
    }
    let old_keys:BTreeSet<_>=previous.into_iter().flat_map(|s|s.backfills.iter().map(Backfill::key)).collect();
    let restored_tables:BTreeSet<i64>=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT DISTINCT n.t FROM _dormant_narrow_rows n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=n.t AND r.id=n.id)")?.query_map([],|r|r.get(0))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?;
    let entering:Vec<_>=next.backfills.iter().filter(|f|!old_keys.contains(&f.key()) || tx.num(&f.table).is_ok_and(|t|restored_tables.contains(&t))).collect();
    if entering.is_empty(){return Ok(())}
    let populated = entering.iter().try_fold(false, |any,fill| -> Result<bool,RuntimeError> {
        Ok(any || tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE t=?1)",[tx.num(&fill.table)?],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))?)
    })?;
    if !populated {return Ok(())}
    let mut source=previous.cloned().unwrap_or_default();source.tables=sources.clone();source.backfills.clear();
    // Point lookup indexes are rebuilt against the assembled source images,
    // including restored rows, before any output patch is applied.
    let mut reads=BTreeSet::new();
    for f in &entering {collect_reads(&f.program.body,&mut reads);}
    for (name,index) in &reads {
        let wanted=next.table(name).and_then(|t|t.index(&index)).ok_or_else(||refusal("backfill lookup index absent"))?;
        let old_table=source.tables.get_mut(name).ok_or_else(||refusal(format!("backfill lookup source {name} has no historical definition")))?;
        if !wanted.is_plain() || wanted.columns().iter().any(|c|c!="id" && !old_table.columns.contains_key(c)) {return Err(refusal(format!("backfill lookup {name}.{index} requires predecessor fields; use an indexed bridge")))}
        old_table.indexes.insert(index.clone(),wanted.clone());
    }
    tx.conn().execute_batch("CREATE TEMP TABLE _backfill_pending(t INTEGER NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,definition TEXT NOT NULL,patch TEXT NOT NULL,evidence TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(t,id,definition)) WITHOUT ROWID;")?;
    tx.conn().execute_batch("CREATE TEMP TABLE _backfill_originals(t INTEGER NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(t,id)) WITHOUT ROWID;")?;
    let entering_keys:BTreeSet<_>=entering.iter().map(|f|f.key()).collect();
    let mut epochs=BTreeSet::from([None]);
    for key in &entering_keys {
        let mut q=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT DISTINCT epoch FROM _backfill_evidence WHERE definition=?1 AND active=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=_backfill_evidence.t AND r.id=_backfill_evidence.id)")?;
        for epoch in q.query_map([key],|r|r.get::<_,i64>(0))? {epochs.insert(Some(epoch?));}
    }
    let fresh_epoch=tx.meta("generation")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<i64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0).saturating_add(1);
    for epoch in epochs {
        restore_snapshot(tx)?;
        if let Some(epoch)=epoch { historical_snapshot(tx,epoch,&next_keys)?; } else { inactive_snapshot(tx,previous,&entering_keys)?; }
        rebuild_reads(tx,&source,&reads)?;
    for fill in &entering {

        let t=tx.num(&fill.table)?;let key=fill.key();let table=&next.tables[&fill.table];let mut bad=super::adopt_refusals::Samples::default();let mut count=0;
        super::activation::walk(tx,t,|id,mut row|{
            if old_keys.contains(&key) && !tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",params![t,id],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? {return Ok(())}
            let prior=evidence(tx,t,id,&key)?;
            if prior.as_ref().filter(|e|e.active).map(|e|e.epoch)!=epoch {return Ok(())}
            let original:Option<String>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data FROM temp._backfill_originals WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
            let current:Value=if let Some(text)=original {decode(&text)?}else{row.clone()};
            if prior.is_none() && tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _backfill_pruned WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND definition=?3)",params![t,id,key],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? {
                bad.add(id,"historical backfill evidence was explicitly pruned; cannot safely re-enter this declaration; use a new bridge or restore a backup");return Ok(())
            }
            for c in fill.inputs.keys() {
                if tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3 AND invalid=1)",params![t,id,c],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? {
                    bad.add(id,&format!("historical reference {}.{c} lost its parent lifetime",fill.table));return Ok(())
                }
            }
            let physically_absent=absence(tx,t,id,"")?;
            let native=absence(tx,t,id,&format!("$native:{key}"))?;
            if prior.is_none() && !native.is_empty() {
                let native_inputs=native_inputs(tx,t,id,&current,fill.inputs.keys().map(String::as_str),&physically_absent)?;
                if fill.inputs.iter().any(|(c,kind)|!physically_absent.contains(c) && crate::engine::validate::validate_column(&fill.table,c,kind,native_inputs.get(c)).is_err()) {
                    bad.add(id,"native image has an invalid present historical input; use a typed bridge");return Ok(())
                }
                if tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _backfill_evidence WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM _backfill_pruned WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",params![t,id],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? {
                    bad.add(id,"native output also has a different transformation's history; resolve its intended view in a bridge");return Ok(())
                }
                let complete=fill.outputs.iter().all(|c|current.field(c).is_ok() && crate::engine::validate::validate_column(&fill.table,c,&table.columns[c],current.field(c).ok()).is_ok());
                let fingerprint=crate::value::digest(&native_inputs);
                if !complete {bad.add(id,"native backfill output image is missing or was explicitly pruned; use a bridge or restore a backup");return Ok(())}
                if !native.contains(&fingerprint) {bad.add(id,"native backfill inputs changed after row creation; preserve the authored output in a bridge before re-entry");return Ok(())}
                return Ok(())
            }
            let original_absence=prior.as_ref().filter(|e|e.active).map_or_else(||physically_absent.intersection(&fill.inputs.keys().cloned().collect()).cloned().collect(),|e|e.absent.clone());
            if let Some(table)=sources.get(&fill.table){materialize_optional_fields(&mut row,table);}
            let historical=row.clone();
            let mut args=BTreeMap::new();
            for (c,kind) in &fill.inputs {
                let value=historical.field(c).cloned().ok();
                if crate::engine::validate::validate_column(&fill.table,c,kind,value.as_ref()).is_err() {
                    bad.add(id,&format!("historical input {}.{c} is absent or does not fit {kind}; use a typed bridge to repair it",fill.table));return Ok(())
                }
                args.insert(c.clone(),value.unwrap_or(Value::Null));
            }
            let inputs=Value::Row(args.clone().into());
            let mut context=Context::system().at(now);context.args=args;
            let mut runner=Runner::new(tx,&source,context,Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort),0);
            let patch=match runner.run(&fill.program) {Ok(Value::Row(f)|Value::Map(f))=>f.into_iter().collect::<BTreeMap<_,_>>(),Ok(_)=>{bad.add(id,"backfill did not return an object");return Ok(())},Err(e)=>{bad.add(id,&e.to_string());return Ok(())}};
            if runner.read_cut().is_some() {bad.add(id,"historical lookup did not complete; reduce per-row lookup work before adoption");return Ok(())}
            if patch.keys().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()!=fill.outputs {return Err(refusal("backfill returned undeclared output fields"))}
            let fields=current.as_object()?;let mut before=prior.as_ref().filter(|e|e.active).map_or_else(BTreeMap::new,|e|e.before.clone());let mut desired=patch.clone();
            for (c,value) in &patch {
                if let Err(e)=crate::engine::validate::validate_column(&fill.table,c,&table.columns[c],Some(value)) {bad.add(id,&e.to_string());return Ok(())}
                if let Some(kind)=sources.get(&fill.table).and_then(|t|t.columns.get(c)) {if protected(kind) && prior.as_ref().is_none_or(|e|e.before.contains_key(c)) {bad.add(id,&format!("cannot overwrite historical reference or asset {}.{c}; derive into a new column",fill.table));return Ok(())}}
                if !prior.as_ref().is_some_and(|e|e.active) && (previous.and_then(|s|s.table(&fill.table)).is_some_and(|t|t.columns.contains_key(c)) || (previous.and_then(|s|s.table(&fill.table)).is_none() && sources.get(&fill.table).is_some_and(|t|t.columns.contains_key(c)))) {
                    if let Some(v)=historical.field(c).ok(){before.insert(c.clone(),v.clone());}
                }
                if let Some(prior)=&prior {
                    let deps_same=prior.inputs==inputs && prior.after==patch;
                    let current=fields.get(c);
                    let original=prior.before.get(c);
                    if deps_same && (prior.active || original.is_none()) && current.is_some() {
                        // Added columns retain edits under v1's dormant storage.
                        desired.insert(c.clone(),current.unwrap().clone());
                    } else if !deps_same && current!=prior.after.get(c) && current!=original {
                        bad.add(id,&format!("{}.{} was edited and its historical inputs changed; keep a bridge and resolve the conflict",fill.table,c));return Ok(())
                    }
                }
            }
            let e=Evidence{absent:original_absence,epoch:epoch.unwrap_or(fresh_epoch),active:true,inputs,before,after:patch};
            tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO temp._backfill_pending VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5)",params![t,id,key,canonical_json(&desired),canonical_json(&e)])?;count+=1;
            Ok(())
        })?;
        if bad.count>0{return Err(refusal(format!("backfill {} {}: {}",fill.table,fill.name,bad.describe())))}
        if count>0{report.backfills.push(format!("{} {} transformed {count} {}",fill.table,fill.name,if count==1 {"row"}else{"rows"}));}
    }
    }
    restore_snapshot(tx)?;
    // Stream patches; avoid retaining the whole transformed population in RAM.
    let mut stmt=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT t,id,definition,patch,evidence FROM temp._backfill_pending ORDER BY t,id,definition")?;
    let mut rows=stmt.query([])?;
    while let Some(r)=rows.next()? {
        let t:i64=r.get(0)?;let id:String=r.get(1)?;let key:String=r.get(2)?;
        let patch:BTreeMap<String,Value>=decode(&r.get::<_,String>(3)?)?;let e:Evidence=decode(&r.get::<_,String>(4)?)?;
        let data:String=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id],|r|r.get(0))?;let mut row:Value=decode(&data)?;
        if let Value::Row(f)|Value::Map(f)=&mut row {f.extend(patch);}
        tx.conn().execute("UPDATE r SET data=?1 WHERE t=?2 AND id=?3",params![canonical_json(&row),t,id])?;
        save(tx,t,&id,&key,&e,true)?;
        for c in e.after.keys() {tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _backfill_absence WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND definition='' AND column_name=?3",params![t,id,c])?;}
        let fill=next.backfills.iter().find(|f|f.key()==key).ok_or_else(||refusal("missing historical declaration"))?;
        for(c,kind)in &fill.inputs {
            if let Ok(value)=e.inputs.field(c) {super::dormant::capture_refs(tx,t,&id,&input_ref(&key,c),kind,value)?;}
        }
    }
    drop(rows);drop(stmt);
    tx.conn().execute_batch("DROP TABLE temp._backfill_pending; DROP TABLE temp._backfill_originals;")?;
    // The source-index rebuild and every transformed dependency require full
    // candidate key/cap/maintain validation, even when its declaration is equal.
    tx.set_meta("activation_population","true")?;
    Ok(())
}
fn collect_reads(body:&[crate::ir::Stmt],out:&mut BTreeSet<(String,String)>){
    use crate::ir::{Expr,Stmt};
    fn expr(e:&Expr,out:&mut BTreeSet<(String,String)>){match e{
        Expr::Scan(r)=>{out.insert((r.table.clone(),r.index.clone()));for k in &r.prefix{if let Some(e)=k.scalar(){expr(e,out);}}if let Some(range)=&r.range {for e in [&range.gt,&range.gte,&range.lt,&range.lte].into_iter().flatten(){expr(e,out);}}if let Some(e)=&r.filter{expr(e,out);}},
        Expr::Get(r)|Expr::Exists(r)=>{out.insert((r.table.clone(),r.index.clone()));for e in &r.key{expr(e,out);}},
        Expr::Field{base,..}|Expr::Unary{value:base,..}=>expr(base,out),Expr::Array(es)|Expr::Builtin{args:es,..}=>{for e in es{expr(e,out);}},
        Expr::Object(fs)=>{for e in fs.values(){expr(e,out);}},Expr::Shape{base,fields}=>{expr(base,out);for e in fields.values(){expr(e,out);}},
        Expr::Binary{left,right,..}=>{expr(left,out);expr(right,out);},Expr::Block{body,value}=>{collect_reads(body,out);expr(value,out);},_=>()
    }}
    for s in body{match s{Stmt::Let{value,..}|Stmt::Const{value,..}|Stmt::Assign{value,..}|Stmt::Return(value)=>expr(value,out),Stmt::Require{condition,..}=>expr(condition,out),Stmt::If{condition,then_body,else_body}=>{expr(condition,out);collect_reads(then_body,out);collect_reads(else_body,out);},_=>()}}
}

// Prune forgets historical values, retaining only the fact that exact reversal
// is no longer available. No tombstone can be queried by an app.
pub(super) fn prune(tx:&Tx<'_>)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    if present(tx)? {tx.conn().execute_batch("DELETE FROM _backfill_evidence WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=_backfill_evidence.t AND r.id=_backfill_evidence.id); DELETE FROM _backfill_pruned WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=_backfill_pruned.t AND r.id=_backfill_pruned.id); INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _backfill_pruned SELECT t,id,definition,active FROM _backfill_evidence; DELETE FROM _backfill_evidence; DELETE FROM _backfill_absence WHERE (definition!='' AND definition NOT LIKE '$native:%') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=_backfill_absence.t AND r.id=_backfill_absence.id);")?;}
    Ok(())
}
pub(super) fn inventory_sql(conn:&Connection)->Result<&'static str,RuntimeError>{
    let exists:bool=conn.query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name='_backfill_evidence')",[],|r|r.get(0))?;
    Ok(if exists {" UNION ALL SELECT c.name||'.backfill#'||substr(e.definition,1,12),'backfill',c.name,e.definition FROM _backfill_evidence e JOIN _catalog c ON c.num=e.t GROUP BY e.t,e.definition "}else{""})
}

pub(super) fn has_evidence(tx:&Tx<'_>)->Result<bool,RuntimeError>{present(tx)}
pub(super) fn columns(tx:&Tx<'_>,next:&Schema)->Result<BTreeMap<String,BTreeSet<String>>,RuntimeError>{
    let mut out:BTreeMap<String,BTreeSet<String>>=BTreeMap::new();
    for f in &next.backfills {out.entry(f.table.clone()).or_default().extend(f.outputs.iter().cloned());}
    if present(tx)? {
        let mut statement=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT definition FROM _backfill_definitions WHERE digest IN (SELECT definition FROM _backfill_evidence WHERE active=1 UNION SELECT definition FROM _backfill_pruned WHERE active=1)")?;
        for text in statement.query_map([],|r|r.get::<_,String>(0))? {
            let f:Backfill=decode(&text?)?;out.entry(f.table).or_default().extend(f.outputs);
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}
fn validate_lookup(tx:&Tx<'_>,ti:i64,prefix:usize,table:&str,index:&str)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    let mut stmt=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT k,id FROM i WHERE ti=?1 ORDER BY k")?;let mut rows=stmt.query([ti])?;
    let mut prior=None;let mut first=String::new();let mut duplicate=false;let mut bad=super::adopt_refusals::Samples::default();
    while let Some(row)=rows.next()? {
        let key:Vec<u8>=row.get(0)?;let id:String=row.get(1)?;let mut group=crate::key::decode(&key).ok_or_else(||refusal("invalid historical lookup key"))?;group.truncate(prefix);
        if group.contains(&Value::Null){continue;}
        if prior.as_ref()==Some(&group) {
            if !duplicate {bad.add(&first,"duplicate historical lookup key");duplicate=true;}
            bad.add(&id,"duplicate historical lookup key");
        }else{prior=Some(group);first=id;duplicate=false;}
    }
    if bad.count>0{return Err(refusal(format!("historical lookup {table}.{index} is not unique: {}; prepare a unique bridge before deriving values",bad.describe())))}
    Ok(())
}

// Each original adoption cohort saw one snapshot. Re-entry restores that same
// view across all its declarations; later cohorts read earlier cohorts' outputs.
fn restore_snapshot(tx:&Tx<'_>)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    tx.conn().execute("UPDATE r SET data=(SELECT o.data FROM temp._backfill_originals o WHERE o.t=r.t AND o.id=r.id) WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM temp._backfill_originals o WHERE o.t=r.t AND o.id=r.id)",[])?;Ok(())
}
fn historical_snapshot(tx:&Tx<'_>,epoch:i64,keys:&BTreeSet<String>)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    let mut q=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT t,id,definition FROM _backfill_evidence WHERE active=1 AND epoch=?1 ORDER BY t,id,definition")?;
    let mut rows=q.query([epoch])?;
    while let Some(r)=rows.next()? {
        let t:i64=r.get(0)?;let id:String=r.get(1)?;let key:String=r.get(2)?;if !keys.contains(&key){continue;}
        let data:Option<String>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
        let Some(data)=data else {continue};
        tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO temp._backfill_originals SELECT t,id,data FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id])?;
        let mut row:Value=decode(&data)?;let e=evidence(tx,t,&id,&key)?.unwrap();
        let fields=match &mut row {Value::Row(f)|Value::Map(f)=>f,_=>return Err(refusal("invalid historical row"))};
        if let Value::Row(inputs)|Value::Map(inputs)=e.inputs {for(c,value)in inputs {
            if e.absent.contains(&c) || !fields.contains_key(&c) || fields.get(&c)==Some(&value) {
                let invalid:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3 AND invalid=1)",params![t,id,input_ref(&key,&c)],|r|r.get(0))?;
                if invalid {return Err(refusal(format!("historical backfill reference {c} on {id} lost its parent lifetime")));}
                if e.absent.contains(&c) {fields.insert(c,value);}else{fields.entry(c).or_insert(value);}
            }
        }}
        for c in e.after.keys() {if !e.before.contains_key(c) {fields.insert(c.clone(),Value::Null);}}
        for(c,value)in e.before {fields.insert(c,value);}
        tx.conn().execute("UPDATE r SET data=?1 WHERE t=?2 AND id=?3",params![canonical_json(&row),t,id])?;
    } Ok(())
}
fn rebuild_reads(tx:&Tx<'_>,source:&Schema,reads:&BTreeSet<(String,String)>)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    for (name,index) in reads {
        let old=&source.tables[name].indexes[index];let ti=tx.num(&format!("{name}.{index}"))?;
        tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM i WHERE ti=?1",[ti])?;
        super::activation::walk(tx,tx.num(name)?,|id,mut row|{
            materialize_optional_fields(&mut row,&source.tables[name]);
            for key in index_keys(old,&row,id){tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO i(ti,k,id) VALUES(?1,?2,?3)",params![ti,key,id])?;}Ok(())
        })?;
        if old.unique {validate_lookup(tx,ti,old.components.len(),name,index)?;}
    } Ok(())
}

fn input_ref(key:&str,column:&str)->String {format!("$backfill:{key}:{column}")}

// A prior transformation's retained added output is not its own old argument
// on forward selection after rollback. Other declarations still see the new
// predecessor snapshot rather than an old cohort's overwritten columns.
fn inactive_snapshot(tx:&Tx<'_>,previous:Option<&Schema>,keys:&BTreeSet<String>)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    let mut q=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT t,id,definition FROM _backfill_evidence WHERE active=0 ORDER BY t,id,definition")?;
    let mut rows=q.query([])?;
    while let Some(r)=rows.next()? {
        let t:i64=r.get(0)?;let id:String=r.get(1)?;let key:String=r.get(2)?;if !keys.contains(&key){continue;}
        let name:String=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT name FROM _catalog WHERE num=?1",[t],|r|r.get(0))?;
        let old=previous.and_then(|s|s.table(&name));
        let e=evidence(tx,t,&id,&key)?.unwrap();
        let absent:Vec<_>=e.after.keys().filter(|c|!e.before.contains_key(*c) && old.is_none_or(|t|!t.columns.contains_key(*c))).cloned().collect();
        if absent.is_empty(){continue;}
        let data:Option<String>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;let Some(data)=data else{continue};
        tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO temp._backfill_originals SELECT t,id,data FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id])?;
        let mut row:Value=decode(&data)?;if let Value::Row(fields)|Value::Map(fields)=&mut row {for c in absent {fields.insert(c,Value::Null);}}
        tx.conn().execute("UPDATE r SET data=?1 WHERE t=?2 AND id=?3",params![canonical_json(&row),t,id])?;
    }Ok(())
}

// Empty definition denotes currently omitted physical input cells; a definition
// digest denotes absence at that receipt's adoption. Defaults may materialize
// during retention without turning omitted inputs into authored values.
pub(super) fn prepare_inputs(tx:&Tx<'_>,next:&Schema,previous:Option<&Schema>)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    if next.backfills.is_empty() && previous.is_none_or(|s|s.backfills.is_empty()) && !present(tx)? {return Ok(());}
    enable(tx)?;
    tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _backfill_active",[])?;
    for fill in &next.backfills {tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO _backfill_active VALUES(?1,?2,?3)",params![tx.num(&fill.table)?,fill.key(),canonical_json(&fill.inputs.keys().collect::<Vec<_>>())])?;}
    for fill in next.backfills.iter().chain(previous.into_iter().flat_map(|s|s.backfills.iter())) {
        tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _backfill_definitions VALUES(?1,?2)",params![fill.key(),canonical_json(fill)])?;
        for c in fill.inputs.keys() {tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _backfill_inputs VALUES(?1,?2)",params![tx.num(&fill.table)?,c])?;}
    }
    let tables:Vec<i64>=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT DISTINCT t FROM _backfill_inputs")?.query_map([],|r|r.get(0))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?;
    for t in tables {
        let columns:Vec<String>=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT column_name FROM _backfill_inputs WHERE t=?1")?.query_map([t],|r|r.get(0))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?;
        super::activation::walk(tx,t,|id,row|{
            for c in &columns {if row.field(c).is_err(){note_omission(tx,t,id,c)?;}}
            Ok(())
        })?;
    } Ok(())
}
pub(super) fn observe_write(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str,table:&Table,row:&Value,old:Option<&Value>)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    if !present(tx)? {return Ok(());}
    if old.is_none() {
        let active:Vec<(String,String)>=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT definition,input_names FROM _backfill_active WHERE t=?1")?.query_map([t],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?)))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?;
        for (key,names) in active {
            let names:Vec<String>=decode(&names)?;let absent=names.iter().filter(|c|row.field(c).is_err()).cloned().collect();
            let fingerprint=input_fingerprint(row,names.iter().map(String::as_str),&absent);
            tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _backfill_absence VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4)",params![t,id,format!("$native:{key}"),fingerprint])?;
        }
    }
    let columns:Vec<String>=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT column_name FROM _backfill_inputs WHERE t=?1")?.query_map([t],|r|r.get(0))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?;
    if columns.is_empty(){return Ok(());}
    let interpreted_old=old.map(|r|crate::schema::row_image(r,table));
    let interpreted_new=crate::schema::row_image(row,table);
    for c in columns {
        let changed=interpreted_old.as_ref().is_none_or(|before|before.field(&c).ok()!=interpreted_new.field(&c).ok());
        if changed {tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _backfill_absence WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",params![t,id,c])?;}
        if row.field(&c).is_err() {note_omission(tx,t,id,&c)?;}
    } Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn record_omissions(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str,row:&Value)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    if !present(tx)? {return Ok(());}
    let columns:Vec<String>=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT column_name FROM _backfill_inputs WHERE t=?1")?.query_map([t],|r|r.get(0))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?;
    for c in columns {if row.field(&c).is_err(){note_omission(tx,t,id,&c)?;}}Ok(())
}

fn input_fingerprint<'a>(row:&Value,names:impl Iterator<Item=&'a str>,absent:&BTreeSet<String>)->String {
    let fields:BTreeMap<String,Value>=names.map(|c|(c.to_owned(),if absent.contains(c){Value::Null}else{row.field(c).cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null)})).collect();
    crate::value::digest(&fields)
}

fn note_omission(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str,c:&str)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    // A provided historical cell stays provided when merely moved out of the
    // active projection. Already-recorded omission survives default freezing.
    tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _backfill_absence SELECT ?1,?2,'',?3 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3)",params![t,id,c])?;Ok(())
}
fn native_inputs<'a>(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str,row:&Value,names:impl Iterator<Item=&'a str>,absent:&BTreeSet<String>)->Result<BTreeMap<String,Value>,RuntimeError>{
    let mut out=BTreeMap::new();let mut meter=Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort);
    for c in names {
        let value=if absent.contains(c){Value::Null}else if let Ok(value)=row.field(c){meter.heap(value.retained_heap_bytes().saturating_mul(64).saturating_add(8192))?;value.clone()}else{
            let bytes:Option<i64>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT octet_length(data) FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",params![t,id,c],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
            meter.heap(bytes.unwrap_or(0).max(0) as u64 * 64 + 8192)?;
            let text:Option<String>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",params![t,id,c],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
            text.map(|s|decode(&s)).transpose()?.unwrap_or(Value::Null)
        };out.insert(c.to_owned(),value);
    }Ok(out)
}

   227	fn collect_reads(body:&[crate::ir::Stmt],out:&mut BTreeSet<(String,String)>){
   228	    use crate::ir::{Expr,Stmt};
   229	    fn expr(e:&Expr,out:&mut BTreeSet<(String,String)>){match e{
   230	        Expr::Scan(r)=>{out.insert((r.table.clone(),r.index.clone()));for k in &r.prefix{if let Some(e)=k.scalar(){expr(e,out);}}if let Some(range)=&r.range {for e in [&range.gt,&range.gte,&range.lt,&range.lte].into_iter().flatten(){expr(e,out);}}if let Some(e)=&r.filter{expr(e,out);}},
   231	        Expr::Get(r)|Expr::Exists(r)=>{out.insert((r.table.clone(),r.index.clone()));for e in &r.key{expr(e,out);}},
   232	        Expr::Field{base,..}|Expr::Unary{value:base,..}=>expr(base,out),Expr::Array(es)|Expr::Builtin{args:es,..}=>{for e in es{expr(e,out);}},
   233	        Expr::Object(fs)=>{for e in fs.values(){expr(e,out);}},Expr::Shape{base,fields}=>{expr(base,out);for e in fields.values(){expr(e,out);}},
   234	        Expr::Binary{left,right,..}=>{expr(left,out);expr(right,out);},Expr::Block{body,value}=>{collect_reads(body,out);expr(value,out);},_=>()
   235	    }}
   236	    for s in body{match s{Stmt::Let{value,..}|Stmt::Const{value,..}|Stmt::Assign{value,..}|Stmt::Return(value)=>expr(value,out),Stmt::Require{condition,..}=>expr(condition,out),Stmt::If{condition,then_body,else_body}=>{expr(condition,out);collect_reads(then_body,out);collect_reads(else_body,out);},_=>()}}
   237	}

   239	// Prune forgets historical values, retaining only the fact that exact reversal
   240	// is no longer available. No tombstone can be queried by an app.
   241	pub(super) fn prune(tx:&Tx<'_>)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
   242	    if present(tx)? {tx.conn().execute_batch("DELETE FROM _backfill_evidence WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=_backfill_evidence.t AND r.id=_backfill_evidence.id); DELETE FROM _backfill_pruned WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=_backfill_pruned.t AND r.id=_backfill_pruned.id); INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _backfill_pruned SELECT t,id,definition,active FROM _backfill_evidence; DELETE FROM _backfill_evidence; DELETE FROM _backfill_absence WHERE (definition!='' AND definition NOT LIKE '$native:%') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=_backfill_absence.t AND r.id=_backfill_absence.id);")?;}
   243	    Ok(())

   245	pub(super) fn inventory_sql(conn:&Connection)->Result<&'static str,RuntimeError>{
//! Release activation extends the existing engine transaction and generation.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#5-hot-activation-and-ownership — CAS includes every activation, not only semantic changes.
use super::*;
use rusqlite::OptionalExtension;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct ReleaseActivation {
    pub release: u64,
    pub expected_previous: Option<u64>,
    pub expected_revision: Option<u64>,
    pub restore_dormant: bool,
    pub native_digest: Option<String>,
    pub operation: String,
}
impl ReleaseActivation {
    pub fn new(release: u64, expected_previous: Option<u64>) -> Self {
        Self {
            release,
            expected_previous,
            expected_revision: None,
            restore_dormant: true,
            native_digest: None,
            operation: "activate".into(),
        }
    }
    pub(crate) fn check(&self, conn: &rusqlite::Connection) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let actual: Option<String> = conn
            .query_row("SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key='release'", [], |r| {
                r.get(0)
            })
            .optional()?;
        if actual
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|s| s.parse::<u64>().ok() != self.expected_previous)
        {
            return Err(RuntimeError::Generation("current release changed; run `snapback4 releases <dir>` and retry the selected release".into()));
        }
        let revision: Option<String> = conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key='release_revision'",
                [],
                |r| r.get(0),
            )
            .optional()?;
        let revision = revision.and_then(|v| v.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        if self.expected_revision.is_some_and(|n| n != revision) {
            return Err(RuntimeError::Generation("activation revision changed (including rollback/equal-content activation); run `snapback4 releases <dir>` and retry".into()));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Engine {
    pub fn new_release(
        store: Store,
        schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        release: u64,
        expected_previous: Option<u64>,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        Self::new_release_with_feed_adoption(
            store,
            schema,
            programs,
            release,
            expected_previous,
            false,
        )
    }
    pub fn new_release_with_feed_adoption(
        store: Store,
        schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        release: u64,
        expected_previous: Option<u64>,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        Self::new_release_prepared(
            store,
            schema,
            programs,
            &ReleaseActivation::new(release, expected_previous),
            allow_feed_adoption,
        )
    }
    pub fn new_release_prepared(
        store: Store, schema: Schema, programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation, allow_feed_adoption: bool,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        Self::new_release_prepared_at(store,schema,programs,options,allow_feed_adoption,crate::now_ms())
    }
    pub fn new_release_prepared_at(
        mut store: Store,
        mut schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        prepare(&mut schema)?;
        let programs = programs.into_iter().map(|p| (p.name.clone(), p)).collect();
        let (generation, metadata) = Self::activate(
            &mut store,
            &schema,
            &programs,
            Some(options),
            now,
            allow_feed_adoption,
            None,
            None,
        )?;
        store.exclude_ephemeral(&schema);
        Ok(Self {
            timeline_schedule: timeline::Schedule::default(),
            ephemeral: std::sync::Arc::new(ephemeral::Hub::new(
                metadata.store_id,
                generation,
                &schema,
            )),
            store,
            schema,
            programs,
            generation,
            expiry_after: BTreeMap::new(),
            dev_effects: false,
            ceilings: Ceilings::default(),
            entropy: crate::ids::seed(),
            minter: crate::ids::Mint::default(),
            #[cfg(feature = "native")]
            native: None,
            #[cfg(feature = "native")]
            native_logs: native::Logs::default(),
            presence: None,
        })
    }
    /// No replacement engine, post-commit SQL read, or fallible ephemeral swap.
    pub fn adopt_release(
        &mut self, schema: Schema, programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation, allow_feed_adoption: bool,
    ) -> Result<u64, RuntimeError> {
        self.adopt_release_at(schema,programs,options,allow_feed_adoption,crate::now_ms())
    }
    pub fn adopt_release_at(
        &mut self,
        mut schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<u64, RuntimeError> {
        prepare(&mut schema)?;
        let programs = programs.into_iter().map(|p| (p.name.clone(), p)).collect();
        drop(self.ephemeral.lock()?);
        let (generation, metadata) = Self::activate(
            &mut self.store,
            &schema,
            &programs,
            Some(options),
            now,
            allow_feed_adoption,
            None,
            None,
        )?;
        self.store.exclude_ephemeral(&schema);
        self.timeline_schedule = timeline::Schedule::default();
        self.schema = schema;
        self.programs = programs;
        self.generation = generation;
        self.expiry_after.clear();
        self.dev_effects = false;
        self.ephemeral
            .rebind_committed(metadata.store_id, generation, &self.schema);
        Ok(generation)
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "native")]
    pub fn set_prepared_native(&mut self, module: Option<std::sync::Arc<native::Module>>) {
        self.native = module;
    }
}

fn prepare(schema: &mut Schema) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    columns::validate_before_prepare(schema)?;
    schema.check_row_view_audiences()?;
    schema.prepare_contribution_indexes();
    schema.prepare_delivery_lookup();
    if let Some(issue) = crate::schema::validate(schema).first() {
        return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(format!(
            "{}: {}",
            issue.path, issue.message
        )));
    }
    Ok(())
}
//! Server activation builder; all fallible work precedes commit.
use super::*;
impl Engine {
    pub(super) fn activate(
        store: &mut Store,
        schema: &Schema,
        programs: &BTreeMap<String, Program>,
        release: Option<&release::ReleaseActivation>,
        now: i64,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
        expected_release: Option<u64>,
        expected_backend: Option<&crate::store::opening::Backend>,
    ) -> Result<(u64, crate::store::opening::Metadata), RuntimeError> {
        schema.validate_column_owners()?;
        for program in programs.values() {
            crate::schema::ephemeral::admit_program(schema, program)?;
            admission::check_state_predicates(schema, program)?;
        }
        for program in programs.values() {
            for table in crate::ir::read_sites(program)
                .into_iter()
                .map(|s| s.table)
                .chain(crate::ir::write_tables(program).into_iter().map(|(t, _)| t))
            {
                schema.refuse_private(&table)?;
            }
        }
        for schedule in &schema.schedules {
            if !schedule.valid()
            {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(format!(
                    "schedule {} has an invalid period or offset",
                    schedule.name
                )));
            }
            let Some(program) = programs
                .get(&schedule.target)
                .filter(|p| matches!(p.kind, ProgramKind::Job | ProgramKind::Action))
            else {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(format!(
                    "schedule {} names missing job or action {}; restore or remove the schedule",
                    schedule.name, schedule.target
                )));
            };
            if program.kind == ProgramKind::Action {
                let seat = schedule
                    .service
                    .as_deref()
                    .filter(|seat| crate::identity::is_service(seat))
                    .ok_or_else(|| {
                        RuntimeError::Schema(
                            "a scheduled action requires its declared service seat".into(),
                        )
                    })?;
                actions::authorize(program, seat)?;
            } else if schedule.service.is_some() {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(
                    "a scheduled job cannot name a service seat".into(),
                ));
            }
            if program.args.iter().any(|(name, kind)| {
                !matches!(name.as_str(), "periodStart" | "periodEnd")
                    || *kind != crate::ir::ArgType::Time
            }) {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(
                    "scheduled work takes periodStart: time and periodEnd: time, or nothing".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        let prior_items = std::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new());
        let population=std::cell::Cell::new(None);
        let outcome=store.activate_at_with_launch(schema, Some(programs), false, now, allow_feed_adoption, |conn| {
            Store::check_selected_release(conn, expected_release)?;
            if let Some(backend) = expected_backend { backend.check(conn)?; }
            if let Some(options)=release {
                options.check(conn)?;
                *prior_items.borrow_mut()=crate::store::release_history::inventory(conn,None,usize::MAX)?;
                crate::store::dormant::enable(conn)?;
                conn.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key,value) VALUES('release_native_digest',?1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value",[options.native_digest.as_deref().unwrap_or("")])?;
                conn.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key,value) VALUES('activation_restore',?1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value",[if options.restore_dormant {"true"}else{"false"}])?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }, |tx, changed, report| {
            let now=now.max(tx.time_audience_clock()?);
            if let Some(options)=release {tx.set_meta("release",&options.release.to_string())?;}
            use rusqlite::OptionalExtension;
            let repair_live_sums = tx.conn().query_row("SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key = 'live_sum_candidates'", [], |row| row.get::<_, String>(0)).optional()?.as_deref() != Some("1");
            let previous: Option<String> = tx.conn().query_row("SELECT schema FROM _generations WHERE generation = (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM _meta WHERE key = 'generation')", [], |row| row.get(0)).optional()?;
            let previous: Option<Schema> = previous.map(|text| serde_json::from_str(&text).map_err(|e| RuntimeError::decode(e, RuntimeError::Store))).transpose()?;
            let needs_maintained_id_marker = (schema.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none())
                || previous.as_ref().is_some_and(|old| old.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none())))
                && tx.meta(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META)?.as_deref() != Some(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_VERSION);
            if !changed && !repair_live_sums && !needs_maintained_id_marker { return Ok(()); }
            let repair_maintained_ids = needs_maintained_id_marker
                && previous.as_ref().is_some_and(|old| old.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none()));
            if changed {
                let epoch = tx.next_seq()?;
                for table in partition::changed_group_audiences(previous.as_ref(), schema) {
                    tx.set_meta(&partition::audience_epoch_key(&table), &epoch.to_string())?;
                    tx.set_meta(&partition::audience_epoch_time_key(&table), &now.to_string())?;
                }
            }
            let population_changed=tx.meta("activation_population")?.as_deref()==Some("true");
            let rebuild: Vec<_> = schema.maintains.iter().filter(|m| {
                (changed && (population_changed || previous.as_ref().is_none_or(|old| crate::successor::maintain_rebuild_needed(old, schema, m))))
                    || (repair_maintained_ids && m.row_key.is_none())
                    || (repair_live_sums && matches!(m.kind, crate::schema::MaintainKind::Sum { .. }) && schema.table(&m.source).is_some_and(|source| source.is_expiring()))
            }).collect();
            tx.set_meta("live_sum_candidates", "1")?;
            if needs_maintained_id_marker {
                // This write is inside the activation transaction: a failed
                // rebuild leaves both old rows and the old/missing marker. A
                // first aggregate has no legacy target identity to rewrite,
                // but records the current address function for later opens.
                tx.set_meta(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META, crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_VERSION)?;
            }
            let attribution = recorded::paths_changed(schema, previous.as_ref());
            let columns = column_activation::changed_parents(schema, if population_changed {None} else {previous.as_ref()});
            if rebuild.is_empty() && !attribution && columns.is_empty() && !repair_maintained_ids { return Ok(()); }
            let seq = tx.next_seq()?;
            let phase = std::time::Instant::now();
            if attribution {
                // This runner owns only activation rewrites; ordinary rebuilds
                // below retain their commit and partition accounting.
                let mut capture = Runner::new(tx, schema, Context::system().at(now), Meter::new(Ceilings::unbounded(), Cut::Abort), seq);
                capture.capture_activation(previous.as_ref(), Some(report))?;
                report.detail("capture recorded paths", phase);
                // A newly introduced aggregate has no legacy identity map to
                // preserve. Keep its event-free recorded-path rebuild out of
                // commit accounting, as activation did before the address
                // migration existed.
                if !repair_maintained_ids {
                    capture.rebuild_recorded_activation(previous.as_ref(), &rebuild.iter().copied().filter(|m| m.private.is_none()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), report)?;
                }
            }
            let mut runner = Runner::new(tx, schema, Context::system().at(now), Meter::new(Ceilings::unbounded(), Cut::Abort), seq);
            if repair_maintained_ids {
                let started = std::time::Instant::now();
                let rewritten = runner.rewrite_legacy_maintained_references(&rebuild.iter().copied().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(), previous.as_ref(), Some(tx))?;
                if rewritten != 0 { report.changes.push(format!("rewrote {rewritten} legacy aggregate references")); }
                report.detail("rewrite legacy aggregate references", started);
            }
            // Legacy maps must be captured before any activation rebuild can
            // remove their target rows. Recorded values themselves are
            // stamped first so their historical paths may still traverse the
            // predecessor addresses.
            if attribution && repair_maintained_ids {
                runner.rebuild_recorded_activation(previous.as_ref(), &rebuild.iter().copied().filter(|m| m.private.is_none()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), report)?;
            }
            runner.activate_columns(previous.as_ref(), &rebuild, &columns, Some(report))?;
            for maintain in rebuild.into_iter().filter(|m| m.private.is_none()) {
                if !recorded::table_paths_changed(schema.table(&maintain.source), previous.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.table(&maintain.source))) {
                    runner.rebuild_maintain_reported(maintain, report)?;
                }
            }
            let events = runner.events.take();
            let tables: Vec<String> = runner.written_tables.iter().cloned().collect();
            let written = runner.rows_written;
            drop(runner);
            if written > 0 || !columns.is_empty() {
                tx.record_commit(seq, now, "rebuild", crate::SYSTEM_PRINCIPAL, "rebuild", &tables, written)?;
                partition::append(tx, seq, &events)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }, |tx| {
            if let Some(options)=release {
                crate::store::release_history::finalize_restorations(tx)?;
                let mut items=crate::store::release_history::inventory(tx.conn(),None,usize::MAX)?;
                let dormant_items=items.len();
                let mut restored_items=0usize;
                for item in &mut items {
                    let before=prior_items.borrow().iter().find(|i|i.key==item.key).cloned();
                    let count=before.as_ref().map_or(0,|i|i.rows);
                    item.before_rows=Some(count);item.after_rows=Some(item.rows);
                    item.before_sample_ids=Some(before.map_or_else(Vec::new,|i|i.sample_ids));
                    let restored=if item.kind=="rows" {
                        tx.meta(&format!("activation_narrowed_restored:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)
                    } else if item.kind=="column" {tx.meta(&format!("activation_column_restored:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)} else {0};
                    item.restored_rows=Some(restored);
                    if restored>0 {item.action="partially restored".into();restored_items+=1;}
                }
                let remaining:std::collections::BTreeSet<_>=items.iter().map(|i|i.key.clone()).collect();
                for mut item in prior_items.borrow().iter().filter(|i|!remaining.contains(&i.key)).cloned() {
                    let restored=if matches!(item.kind.as_str(),"rows"|"column") {
                        let prefix=if item.kind=="rows" {"activation_narrowed_restored"} else {"activation_column_restored"};
                        tx.meta(&format!("{prefix}:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)
                    } else if item.kind=="table" {
                        tx.meta(&format!("activation_table_restored:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)
                    } else {item.rows};
                    item.action=if restored>0 || item.definition_only {"restored"} else {"removed without restoration"}.into();
                    item.before_rows=Some(item.rows);item.after_rows=Some(0);item.restored_rows=Some(restored);item.before_sample_ids=Some(item.sample_ids.clone());
                    if restored>0 || item.definition_only {restored_items+=1;}
                    items.push(item);
                }
                population.set(Some((tx.meta("activation_narrowed_retained")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0),tx.meta("activation_narrowed_restored")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0))));
                crate::store::release_history::event(tx,&options.operation,Some(options.release),options.expected_previous,serde_json::json!({"dormant_items":dormant_items,"restored_items":restored_items,"native_digest":options.native_digest,"narrowed_retained":tx.meta("activation_narrowed_retained")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0),"narrowed_restored":tx.meta("activation_narrowed_restored")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)}),&items)?;
                tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key IN ('activation_restore','activation_population','activation_narrowed_retained','activation_narrowed_restored') OR key LIKE 'activation_narrowed_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_column_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_table_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_table_restored_ids:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_narrowed_restored_ids:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_column_restored_ids:%'",[])?;
            }
            crate::store::opening::Metadata::read(tx)
        });
        if outcome.is_ok() {
            if let Some((retained,restored))=population.get().filter(|(a,b)|*a>0 || *b>0) {
                store.adoption_report.changes.insert(0,format!("{retained} newly dormant {}; {restored} narrowed {} restored", if retained == 1 { "row" } else { "rows" }, if restored == 1 { "row" } else { "rows" }));
            }
        }
        if outcome.is_ok() {
            if let Ok(items)=store.dormant_inventory(None,usize::MAX) {
                if release.is_some() { store.adoption_report.changes.insert(0, crate::store::adoption_report::AdoptionReport::dormant(&items)); }
            }
        }
        outcome
    }
}
